about_the_game:
"Rogue Realm: Guardian Grids" combines the strategic layout of classic tower defense, the randomized progression of roguelites, and a highly flexible build-crafting system. Facing endless waves of enemies, you must forge your own unique combat system based on the diverse augments and card choices in each run, watching it grow step by step until its ultimate explosive potential is unleashed.

Hold the Line, Forge Your Combat System

Build defense facilities on the grid map to fend off endless waves of enemies. Strategically manage resources and layouts, create strong synergies between your buildings, and survive wave after wave of attacks.

Every Upgrade is a New Path for Growth

After leveling up, you can purchase random augments. These power-ups don't just increase your stats; they alter attack patterns, trigger special effects, and shift your entire build strategy, ensuring every run has a unique progression path.

Draft Cards to Shape Your Strategy

Use resources gained from battles to buy random cards, flexibly adapting your development direction based on your current augments and the battlefield situation. Every purchase is a trade-off, and these choices will ultimately determine how your build takes shape.

From Feeble Firepower to Battlefield Domination

As augments accumulate, your initially simple defense line will gradually evolve into a comprehensive combat machine. Attacks, buffs, and trigger effects synergize layer by layer. Watch the build you crafted kick into high gear, drowning swarms of enemies in pure firepower.

Key Features

  • Roguelite deckbuilding combined with classic tower defense gameplay

  • High-freedom augment system and deep build progression

  • Rich combinations of buildings, cards, and synergistic effects

  • Experience a completely different randomized growth path in every run

  • Unique 3D-rendered pixel art style

  • A complete progression experience from strategic management to late-game explosive power

  • Support endless mode

  • 20-40+ hours of gameplay
requirements_minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 280（Vulkan）
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a Vulkan-compatible GPU.
